name: auto-validation-cargo-provider
prompt: Apply the requested Rust fixture. AUTO_VALIDATION_CARGO_PROVIDER_MARKER

executable_home_files.bin/cargo:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
if [ "$#" -ne 13 ] || [ "$1" != "check" ] || [ "$2" != "--quiet" ] || [ "$3" != "--message-format=json" ] || [ "$4" != "--color" ] || [ "$5" != "never" ] || [ "$6" != "--jobs" ] || [ "$7" != "2" ] || [ "$8" != "--manifest-path" ] || [ "$9" != "{workspace}/Cargo.toml" ] || [ "${10}" != "--target-dir" ] || [ "${12}" != "--locked" ] || [ "${13}" != "--all-targets" ]; then
  printf 'unexpected cargo argv: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 64
fi
case "$PWD" in
  "{workspace}"|"{workspace}"/*) printf 'cargo ran inside workspace: %s\n' "$PWD" >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac
case "${11}" in
  *codex-cargo-validation-*/target) ;;
  *) printf 'unexpected cargo target dir: %s\n' "${11}" >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac
state=$(dirname "$0")/cargo-provider-ran
if [ -f "$state" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
touch "$state"
printf '%s\n' '{"reason":"compiler-message","message":{"level":"error","message":"mismatched types","code":{"code":"E0308"},"spans":[{"file_name":"src/lib.rs","line_start":1,"column_start":25,"is_primary":true}]}}'
exit 101

config_toml:
model_provider = "harness"

[model_providers.harness]
name = "Harness"
base_url = "{responses_base_url}"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

[validation.groups]
functional = true
stylistic = false

[validation.providers.cargo]
enabled = true
command = ["{home}/bin/cargo"]
timeout_ms = 5000

[validation.providers.shellcheck]
enabled = false

item.name: apply_patch
item.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: Cargo.toml
@@
 edition = "2021"
+[lib]
+path = "src/lib.rs"
*** Add File: src/lib.rs
+pub fn value() -> u8 { "bad" }
*** End Patch
